about: SYNTHETIC, written by hand for the corroboration rule (#441 review). A GS1-style Code 128 whose payload carries a GS (U+001D, FNC1) between its fields, and a text line printing the same characters without it. Only space, tab, newline, carriage return and '*' are taken out before comparing, on both twins, so the GS stays and the line does not corroborate it. Kotlin's isWhitespace() counts U+001C-001F as whitespace and Swift's whitespacesAndNewlines does not, which is why the set is spelled out.

lines: Synthetic test ticket - not valid for admission
